- [RLOW.13.7] **Logical emit registers a TMS justifier.**
  `emit X logical` produces a terminal action of kind
  `ACTION_LOGICAL_ASSERT` ([RDSC.4a.8]); the firing activation
  token is the justifier and the fact is retracted when the
  activation ends ([IRET.12]). Restates [RLOW.7.1.3] and
  [RLOW.7.1.4].
